streakCalendar.title: Streak Calendar
streakCalendar.repairFailed: Could not repair that day. Please try again.
streakCalendar.alreadyCounted: That day already counts toward your Streak.

githubLink.title: GitHub Link
githubLink.description: Commit every Accepted submission to a GitHub repository you created, so it shows on your contribution graph.
githubLink.startFailed: Could not start linking. Please try again.
githubLink.privateReminder: This repository is private. Its commits only show on your contribution graph when "Include private contributions" is turned on in your GitHub profile settings.
githubLink.broken: CodeBite can no longer reach this repository. The app may have been uninstalled or the repository deleted. Link again to resume commits.

import.offer: Import your earlier Accepted submissions too. Each becomes its own commit, dated when it was Accepted, so those past days turn green as well.
import.failed: The Import didn't finish. Nothing was added to the repository, so you can try again.
import.startFailed: Could not start the Import. Please try again.

githubLink.unlinkDescription: Accepted submissions will stop being committed to {{repository}}. Everything already in the repository stays as it is. You can link again at any time.
githubLink.unlinkFailed: Could not unlink. Please try again.

callback.missingParams: GitHub did not send back the expected details. Start linking again from your profile.
callback.notAuthorised: Your GitHub account has not authorised this installation of the CodeBite app.
callback.expired: This link request expired or belongs to another account. Start linking again from your profile.
callback.failed: Could not finish linking. Please try again.
callback.chooseRepository: You gave CodeBite access to several repositories. Choose the one to use as your Solution Repository. CodeBite only ever adds solutions to that one.
callback.notGranted: The CodeBite app no longer has access to that repository. Open GitHub again and grant it.
callback.noRepository: You didn't give CodeBite access to any repository. Choose your Solution Repository on GitHub and try again.
